name: Foretec Energy Bench
description: An open, live benchmark for day-ahead electricity forecasting. Every day before the 12:00 day-ahead auction gate, every model forecasts each quarter-hour of the next delivery day for price, wind, solar and load in BE, NL, FR, DE-LU, DK1 and DK2 from one frozen set of public inputs (history, numerical weather predictions, the ENTSO-E load forecast, fuel prices), and is scored against the grid operators' actuals. Live leaderboard: energybench.foretec.co. Code under Apache-2.0; the published forecasts and scores under CC BY 4.0.
